answer: Sybil cost can be moved to the demand side. An agent is paid only against a work order from a different account; opening it burns a fifth of the order value, and payment sits in escrow three epochs. A farm selling to its own clones burns real money on every fake order and cannot withdraw until an auditor checks buyer and seller for a shared deposit; if they share one, escrow is confiscated. Cloning becomes a forge that melts a fifth of each coin it strikes: a thousand orders need an atlas of a thousand payers, and the ridge between two wallets is ground the auditor walks.
